description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Elandon Roberts has agreed to a 1-year contract with the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Roberts played for the Steelers in 2023 and 2024 before joining the Raiders last season, and he will now return to Pittsburgh. The linebacker played in 17 games with Las Vegas, totaling 90 combined tackles and six tackles for loss.
items.title: Elandon Roberts signs 1-year deal with Steelers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Darren Waller has agreed to a 1-year contract with the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Waller will join the Carolina offense after coming out of retirement to play nine games with the Dolphins last season. Tommy Tremble and Ja'Tavion Sanders had headlined the Carolina tight end room, so Waller could see significant playing time if he stays healthy and finds a connection with Bryce Young.
items.title: Darren Waller signs 1-year deal with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jadarian Price went through a walkthrough in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Price makes his return for the first time in five practices. It is a positive sign for the rookie after he has been sidelined the past month.
items.title: Jadarian Price (leg) goes through walkthrough Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Shedeur Sanders will start the second half in Saturday's preseason opener against the Bears.
items.impact: Deshaun Watson has been named the starter and is expected to get the first half. They will likely swap in the second preseason game.
items.title: Shedeur Sanders to start second half in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Deshaun Watson will start at QB for the Browns' preseason opener against the Bears on Saturday.
items.impact: Watson is expected to get the first half with Shedeur Sanders starting the second half. They will likely swap in the second preseason game.
items.title: Deshaun Watson to start preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins practiced for a second straight day on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dobbins is continuing to work his way through a soft tissue injury. It is unclear how much he has been doing in practice.
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (soft tissue) practices again Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Waddle is likely to miss practice all week. He is sidelined with a muscle strain.
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (muscle strain) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Malik Nabers will likely be doing team periods "soon."
items.impact: Nabers could participate in team drills as early as next week. He continues to progress in the right direction.
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) to likely do team drills soon

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos coach Sean Payton said Michael Deiter suffered a season-ending quad injury.
items.impact: Deiter suffered the injury in practice on Monday. He signed with the Broncos practice squad last January.
items.title: Michael Deiter (quad) suffers season-ending injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos coach Sean Payton said Jonathon Cooper will play in the preseason.
items.impact: Cooper was arrested this offseason for six different charges. He will be on the field in the preseason for Denver.
items.title: Jonathon Cooper will play in preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam Ehlinger is expected to play one half in the Broncos preseason opener.
items.impact: Bo Nix is not expected to play. Ehlinger and Jarrett Stidham will both play one half as they compete for the backup job.
items.title: Sam Ehlinger to play one half in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jarrett Stidham is expected to play one half in the Broncos preseason opener.
items.impact: Bo Nix is not expected to play. Stidham and Sam Ehlinger will both play one half as they compete for the backup job.
items.title: Jarrett Stidham to play one half in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bo Nix will not play in the Broncos preseason opener against the Falcons.
items.impact: Nix is expected to play in the second and third preseason games. Jarrett Stidham and Sam Ehlinger will both play a half.
items.title: Bo Nix will not play in preseason opener

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots signed RB Hassan Haskins.
items.impact: Haskins will compete for a depth role in the Patriots backfield.
items.title: Hassan Haskins signs with Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Odell Beckham Jr. will play in the preseason opener on Saturday against the Vikings.
items.impact: Beckham continues to compete for a depth role in the Giants wide receiver room during training camp.
items.title: Odell Beckham Jr. to play in preseason opener

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zamir White is signing with the 49ers.
items.impact: The former Raider finds a new home in San Francisco, who are in need of running back depth due to the amount of injuries they've sustained. It's unlikely that he does much for fantasy, but you never know what Kyle Shanahan might scheme up should White make the final roster.
items.title: Zamir White signing with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka's injury that cut his practice early on Wednesday is a toe issue that's considered minor.
items.impact: Egbuka limped off the field during practice on Wednesday. He is day-to-day for now with the injury being minor.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka dealing with minor toe injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens CB Marlon Humphrey left practice about an hour in with members of team's athletic training and medical staffs on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reason Humphrey left for. There will be an update provided on his status when available.
items.title: Marlon Humphrey exits practice early Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cooper Rush will play in the Falcons preseason opener on Friday against the Broncos.
items.impact: Rush is expected to rotate in after Tua Tagovailoa.
items.title: Cooper Rush to play in preseason opener Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said QB Tua Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason opener against the Broncos.
items.impact: Tagovailoa is expected to play a series or roughly 10 snaps. He is currently the favorite to start Week 1 for the Falcons.
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa to start preseason opener Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders RB Jeremy McNichols did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McNichols misses a second straight practice due to a quad injury. He is competing for a depth role in the Commanders backfield.
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (undisclosed) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders WR Dont'e Thornton missed his fourth straight practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Thornton left a training camp practice early last week. He remains without a clear timetable to return.
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (undisclosed) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans worked out K Joshua Karty.
items.impact: Karty made 39-of-49 field goals over the past two seasons for the Rams. The Titans are looking to bring in competition at the kicker position during training camp.
items.title: Joshua Karty works out for Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets CB Qwan'tez Stiggers was released from the hospital after collapsing at practice.
items.impact: Stiggers collapsed at a joint practice with the Buccaneers Tuesday and was transported to a local hospital. He was released from the hospital by the end of the day.
items.title: Qwan'tez Stiggers released from hospital

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks placed FB Robbie Ouzts (neck) on injured reserve.
items.impact: Ouzts was dealing with a neck injury in the playoffs last season. He'll miss the upcoming year.
items.title: Robbie Ouzts (neck) placed on IR

title: Fantasy Player News
